Run Claude Code in named sessions on a private tmux server that ignores
~/.tmux.conf. Session NAME is the tmux session "cld-NAME", running
"claude --name cld-NAME" with Remote Control on. cld sees only the sessions it
started; tmux -L cld ls lists every session on its server.

Detach with C-q d; C-q C-q sends C-q to claude. A session whose claude fails
stays, showing why, until cld kill ends it.

Usage:
  cld [command]

Available Commands:
  new         create session NAME in the current directory and attach to it
  join        attach to session NAME, detaching any other terminal from it
  kill        end session NAME and the claude running in it
  list        list the sessions cld started
  help        show this help, or the help of COMMAND
  version     show the version

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for cld

Use "cld [command] --help" for more information about a command.
